update.releaseNotes:
v1.9.0 - other screen sizes, sturdier training reads and sparks
- New: reads every screen at a fixed size and maps taps back; tested live on MuMu at 720x1280 and 1440x2560, other phones not (Grand Concert still needs 1080 wide). Optional Daily Sales buying. - Changed: training gains and spark rerolls read more reliably, a recovery skill before a 3000m+ goal race, a silent progress notification. - Fixed: fewer stops after the daily reset and on slow screens. - Presets: three new trainee cards, six support cards; four farming presets removed.
